initialFullBrowserRun.failure: Chromium keyboard file selection: timed out waiting for filechooser after Enter, before any trace import.

unchangedKeyboardRepeat.command: npx playwright test tests/browser/workspace.spec.mjs --project=chromium --grep 'keyboard file selection' --repeat-each=10

diagnostic.method: Same focused button and Enter; record DOM events and native input click. Compare listener first registered just before Enter with listener registered before navigation. Chromium, 15 attempts per group, two workers.
diagnostic.interpretation: Failure occurs despite focus, keyboard activation and a click on a connected file input. Enabling interception before navigation resolves the observed race; no app UI code change is indicated by this experiment.
diagnostic.localDependencyEvidence: playwright-core/lib/coreBundle.js: ChannelOwner._updateSubscription does not await the subscription update; PageDispatcher.updateSubscription installs fileChooser interception asynchronously.
diagnostic.fix: Move the existing page.waitForEvent(filechooser) promise before page.goto. Keep the same Enter gesture and all subsequent import, focus, search and accessibility assertions.
